_comment: Live manifest for the ROCm variant bring-up. One entry per variant; frozen copies are produced per dated tag at publish time.

source._note: sglang/megatron/miles pins same as rocm10-mi35x below

transformer-engine.delivery: source build (TE_USE_WHEEL=0) until a 7.2.4 cp312 shelf exists; note this is TE 2.8, older than the 2.17 the rocm720/rocm10 tracks run

notes: VMM fake-release probe on this base: BUGGY (2026-09-01, vmm_pause_test) -> production use needs the vmmfix .so rebuilt against 7.2.4 (soname .1.18.70204); APPLY_ROCR_VMMFIX stays 0 until then
IPC-export leak probe: dmabuf path leaks 256MB/iter, HSA_ENABLE_IPC_MODE_LEGACY=1 still required and still effective

sglang.delivery: checkout inside base image /sgl-workspace/sglang, pinned via --build-arg SGLANG_COMMIT

megatron.delivery: git clone -b miles-main at build time; Dockerfile has no commit arg, SHA recorded here is the resolved HEAD at manifest time (drift risk until a MEGATRON_COMMIT arg exists)

transformer-engine.ref: miles-te-0814 (= XinyuJiangCMU miles-dev after the 2026-09-01 unification)
transformer-engine.delivery: wheel transformer_engine-2.17.0-cp312 from the rocm10-gfx950-v0.5.18 release (TE_USE_WHEEL=1)

miles.delivery: git clone at build time, pinned via --build-arg MILES_COMMIT

flash_attn-2.8.3-cp312-cp312-linux_x86_6.source: PyPI flash-attn==2.8.3 sdist, GPU_ARCHS=gfx950 BUILD_TARGET=rocm, built in the base container

skipped: vmmfix .so (ROCm 10 runtime has both leak fixes upstream; probed 2026-09-01)
